UserPublicProfile.title: UserPublicProfile
UserPublicProfile.description: Public profile of a user, used for leaderboard and general statistics.

email.description: The user's email address if registered.

selectedLanguage.description: The currently active language being learned (e.g., marathi, hindi, english).

level.description: User's calculated level based on XP.

badges.description: List of badge IDs earned by the user.

lastActiveDate.description: ISO timestamp of the user's last action.

completedLessons.description: Array of completed lesson document IDs.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the account was created.

SiteVisitor.title: SiteVisitor
SiteVisitor.description: Log of site visitors and active user sessions for admin analytics.

userId.description: Associated user UID if logged in.

lastVisitedAt.description: ISO timestamp of most recent visit.

isRegisteredUser.description: Whether visitor is logged in with an email account.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Sensitive personal information stored separately to maintain PII separation.

isAdmin.description: Whether the user has administrative privileges.

Lesson.title: Lesson
Lesson.description: An educational lesson including teaching material and quiz questions.

description.description: Brief summary of what the lesson covers.

content.description: Array of cards or elements for teaching (native word, translation, pronunciation, explanation).

quiz.description: Array of quiz questions associated with this lesson.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the lesson was created.

users/{userId}.description: Collection of public user profile statistics.

users/{userId}/private/info.description: Subcollection isolating PII and admin flags.

site_visitors/{visitorId}.description: Log of site visits and traffic analytics.

lessons/{lessonId}.description: Collection of learning lessons curated by admins and available to users.
